### Finding the Bread of Life
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/finding-the-bread-of-life-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: John 6:35
Points:
- Calling Himself the Bread of Life is a gracious invitation to intimacy rather than a word of condemnation.
- The crowds focused on having their physical bellies filled, overlooking their deeper spiritual hunger.
- Worldly provisions cannot satisfy the soul's longing for love, peace, hope, and redemption.
- Partaking of Jesus daily transforms believers into His likeness and brings lasting spiritual satisfaction.

### Jesus Really Satisfies
Author: Conrad Mbewe
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-really-satisfies
Passage: John 6:35
Points:
- Physical bread is essential to basic biological survival, mirroring how indispensable Christ is to spiritual life.
- Just as hearty food ends physical hunger, coming to Christ halts the search for fulfillment elsewhere.
- Believers can weather sickness, poverty, and trials because Jesus meets their deepest needs.
- Receiving the benefits of the Bread of Life requires personal trust in Him, not merely intellectual assent.

### Jesus is My Comfort Food
Author: Carolyn Dale Newell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/jesus-is-my-comfort-food-encouragement-caf-apr-7-2015.html
Passage: John 6:35
Points:
- Turning to food for relief during distress subtly suggests that God is insufficient to meet our emotional needs.
- Jesus reveals Himself as the true Bread of Life who alone can satisfy and comfort the troubled heart.
- Believers should run to the foot of the cross instead of seeking solace in unhealthy habits.
- Relying on God's strength in prayer enables Christians to exercise discipline and depend on Christ.

### Jesus the Bread of Life
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-bread-life
Passage: John 6:22–51
Points:
- The Old Testament bread of the Presence provided temporary nourishment, pointing forward to Christ's permanent provision.
- Jesus urged the crowds not to strive for perishing food, but for nourishment that endures to eternity.
- Doing the work of God requires placing saving faith in Jesus rather than observing legalistic ceremonies.
- As the true manna sent from heaven, Jesus offers His life for the eternal sustenance of all who believe.
